$comment: CI checks migrations after enforcedFrom. Unregistered contractions fail.
Each entry approves one exact migration surface; it does not exempt the rest of the migration.
expandedIn identifies the replacement surface release; approvedFor identifies the first release allowed to remove/narrow the old surface.
owner and justification record who approved the contraction and why the supported skew window has passed.

rollingUpgradeWindow.note: Released peers must be on the same major version and differ by at most one minor version. HA protocol windows must also intersect.
